_about: Honesty Machine rule set. Each category = one kind of fraud actually caught in the wild. severity 'block' fails CI/pre-commit; 'warn' is reported for human judgment. Replace categories with YOUR project invariants — regex over code with comments stripped. For C-family files string literals are also scanned (GPU kernels hide in strings).
_adaptation: 5 minutes: (1) delete the example categories, (2) write your own invariants as regex lists, (3) drop AGENTS.md into your repo root, (4) run bash install_precommit.sh.

BACKPROP / gradient.why: hidden gradient training inside code that claims to be gradient-free

SOFTMAX.why: softmax where the design forbids it (allowed only as an explicitly labeled baseline)

BATCH-NORM / normalization.why: batch-norm / layer-norm / dropout normalize over the current batch

GLOBAL SELECTION (argmax/topk).why: global argmax/top-k as the selector; the design requires local-dynamics selection. Legitimate in measurement harnesses — context is judged by a human.

RANDOMNESS IN FORWARD.why: forward pass must be deterministic; seeds belong to the test harness only

MEAN / averaging.why: averaging destroys source identity (project principle: summation, not averaging)

normalize (vector — check context).why: vector normalization is legal on the unit sphere; batch normalization is not — context decides

tanh (rejected formula).why: tanh is rejected in this project — EXCEPT legal cases (Poincare geometry); context is judged by a human

MAGIC CONSTANTS (candidates).why: thresholds and ratios must be derived from state (order statistics, escape from data), not invented

_example_custom_category.why: EXAMPLE for your own project: no network calls inside tests
